about.title: Huntington Beach Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Much of Huntington Beach traffic funnels onto two state routes: Pacific Coast Highway (SR-1) along the shore and Beach Boulevard (SR-39) running inland. Public records show those corridors carry the highest collision counts in the city. In 2025, Huntington Beach logged 724 injury collisions, with 1,011 people hurt and 15 lives lost. Reports cluster on Saturday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m., when beach visitors and residents share the same lanes. If you were injured in one of those crashes, the weeks afterward can feel disorganized. Medical bills arrive before the adjuster returns your call. Someone from the other driver's insurer asks for a recorded statement. That is exactly when a bit of guidance helps. LawProactive is a free service, not a law firm. We connect Orange County residents with an independent personal injury attorney who handles car accident claims on contingency. You pay nothing for the connection, and the attorney collects a fee only if there is a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Huntington Beach Drivers Turn to LawProactive

items.title: The clock is already running
items.desc: California gives you two years to file most car accident claims, but if a city or state vehicle was involved, that window can shrink to six months. An early connection means those deadlines get tracked before they become a problem.

items.title: Partial fault does not close the door
items.desc: California follows pure comparative fault, so even if you shared some blame for a Beach Boulevard collision, you can still pursue compensation reduced by your percentage. An attorney can push back when an insurer inflates your share.

items.title: Evidence and statements handled carefully
items.desc: The other driver's insurer may request a recorded statement within days; you are not required to give one. Network attorneys focus on preserving photos, witness contacts, and repair records while managing communication with adjusters on your behalf.

items.question: I was hit on PCH during a busy Saturday afternoon. Does the traffic volume affect my claim?
items.answer: Heavy traffic on Pacific Coast Highway does not change who is legally responsible, but it often means more witnesses and possibly nearby camera footage. Those sources can disappear quickly, so gathering names and photos early matters. An attorney can send preservation requests before that evidence is gone.

items.question: The other driver's insurance company wants a recorded statement. Should I give one?
items.answer: You are under no obligation to provide a recorded statement to the other party's insurer, and doing so before you understand your injuries can work against you. Many attorneys prefer to handle that communication directly. It is reasonable to politely decline until you have spoken with someone representing your interests.

items.question: How much does it cost to talk with an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm, and the independent attorneys in our network work on contingency. That means they receive a fee only if your case results in a recovery, and there is no upfront charge to review your situation.
